newsitem.title: ALBANIA: One dead in Albanian-Macedonian riot.
newsitem.headline: One dead in Albanian-Macedonian riot.

text.p: One person died and 70 were injured in fighting between hundreds of ethnic Albanian protesters and police in Macedonia on Wednesday, police said.

The violence in the west Macedonian town of Gostivar broke out after police removed the Albanian national flag from the town hall following a decision by parliament on Tuesday to limit the display of flags to special occasions.
At least five of the wounded were police hit by gunfire and 30 demonstrators were arrested on suspicion of offences involving firearms, a police statement said.
Petrol bombs were thrown during clashes in which two police cars were detroyed.
Ethnic Albanians who are seeking greater recognition in the former Yugoslav republic have flown the flag of the neighbouring Albania publicly in 20 municipalities they control in western Macedonia.
Albanians claim they amount to 40 percent of the population of Macedonia but the government maintains that census figures show they account for only 22 percent.
